reviewer: Codex visual inspection; no human double annotation
method: Read all 217 queries; inspect all 137 photos in nine sheets; compare visible conditions and confusable alternatives; zoom uncertain OCR, pen, vehicle color and silhouette.
limitations: Single AI reviewer; binary full-corpus judgments may still contain mistakes.
Images are synthetic and most queries have one positive; not representative personal-album accuracy.
